caption: The drawing depicts a set of cast iron shed brackets mounted on the exterior corner of a building. The main section shows an angled perspective where multiple ornate brackets are attached to both a vertical wall surface and a set of horizontal beams overhead. Each bracket features a decorative design with curved and spiraling elements, and the structure includes open areas within the curves. The architectural lines of the beams and wall are illustrated with straight and parallel lines, while the brackets themselves are distinctly more ornate with looping patterns. The lower left corner includes a title reading "CAST IRON SHED BRACKETS." In the lower right, a detailed side view of a single bracket is shown with dimensions marked as 36 inches in height and 55 inches in length. The drawing is rendered in black ink lines on an off-white background, with some washes of light brown or sepia shading behind and around the depicted objects to suggest depth or shadow. The entire composition is contained within a thin rectangular frame.
title: Iron Brackets
